column1: # Omens dune-world-watch whispers to the online players (from OMEN_FROM, default Thufir). One line per omen:
# kind<TAB>text. Kinds: worm-character (a worm goes for a player or a group of them), worm-vehicle, worm-thumper,
# storm (may use {region}). One line of the kind is picked at random; edits apply at the next omen.

column2: The sand trembles beneath you. Shai-Hulud has noticed.
Walk without rhythm, they said. It is too late for that. Run.
Listen. That hiss is not the wind.
The desert remembers your footsteps, and something vast is following them.
Your engine sings to the deep sand, and something is answering.
Shai-Hulud hungers for metal tonight. Get that machine onto rock.
The dunes behind you are rising. Do not slow down.
The thumper calls, and the Maker comes.
Someone has knocked on the desert's door. It is answering.
A Coriolis storm gathers over {region}. Seek shelter before it finds you.
The sky over {region} is turning the color of rust. A storm is coming.
The wind is rising in {region}. The Fremen are already underground.
